fields.Name: New Business
fields.Description: A first sale to a new customer.

fields.Name: Renewal
fields.Description: Continuation of an existing agreement. RequiresRenewalSource is what makes the chain enforceable: the deal must name the contract it renews (Deal.RenewsContractID), and closing it routes to Contracts.RenewTerm rather than Contracts.CreateFromDeal.

fields.Name: Expansion
fields.Description: More of what the customer already buys — seats, volume, tier. A separate deal against the same contract, which is why it is one contract to many deals.

fields.Name: Cross-Sell
fields.Description: A different product line to an existing customer.

fields.Name: Partner-Sourced
fields.Description: Originated by a partner. RequiresContract is 0 as a SEED DEFAULT, not a rule — a referral that resolves to a single one-time order needs no agreement envelope. Set it to 1 if your partner motion is contracted; that is a metadata edit, not a migration.
